arguments.hindsight: The lower board was placed and released across two supports, and one middle support was added. The left middle-support pickup failed, after which the policy continued empty placement motions and installed the middle board prematurely. Grasp verification exposed the failure, but concrete recovery instructions did not redirect the policy.
arguments.reason: The middle layer lacks its left white support and its board rests tilted. Repeated requests to place the missing support or remove the board did not produce those operations; the policy instead returned to the green top piece.
